Name: SH's Jimothy The Raccoon Pet
Author: plurffle
Description:
This little mod just adds the round little raccoon fellow as a custom pet in your game! You can choose him as your very first pet at the start of the game [b]OR[/b] get him over at Marnie's for a customizable price (or free) once you receive the pet license! Once you give him the right amount of love, he may start giving you little gifts of various values ฅ՞•ﻌ•՞ฅ ~ ♡


[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]

[b]Q: How to install this mod?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Unzip the zip file and place the "[CP] SH's Jimothy The Raccon Pet" folder in your Mods folder.

[b]Q: Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]I do not have the mobile version of the game, but I assume it should be work just fine in there since this is a Content Patcher mod. This should definitely work in multiplayer!



I have a Ko-fi btw! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
